initial:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: production 2D game character walk cycle sprite sheet.
Input image 1 is the IDENTITY AND PAINTING reference, especially the FIRST standing figure. Make exactly the SAME child archer in an eight-frame WALK AWAY cycle, seen from behind from the identical slightly elevated top-down camera. This is an animation asset, not a character redesign.
Output a very detailed high resolution transparent RGBA sprite sheet, exactly 4 columns x 2 rows, 8 equal portrait cells, chronological reading order left to right then next row. Canvas 3072 x 2048 if supported. Each character is fully inside its own cell with generous transparent margins, identical body scale and head size, a shared virtual ground plane and centered hip. No grid, text, numbering, floor, cast shadows or checkerboard.
Keep the exact compact black hair bun and red tie, cream quilted short robe, black belt, scalloped overlapping cream skirt panels, dark blue voluminous knee trousers, cream wrapped calves, black cloth shoes with tan soles, brilliant red embroidered scarf flowing to viewer RIGHT, gold carved recurved bow with red bindings held LOW in viewer-left hand. Keep the same precise ink outlines, layered paper-cut / shadow-puppet detailing, warm parchment fabric texture, rich textile embroidery, cloth creases, polished gold ornament, child body proportions and camera as reference first figure. No face visible.
Walk choreography, not running or jumping: 1 left foot forward planted / right back toe-off; 2 weight over left leg, right knee bends and lifts; 3 right swing leg passes beside left support leg; 4 right heel reaches forward to contact; 5 right forward planted / left back toe-off; 6 weight over right leg, left knee bends and lifts; 7 left swing passes beside right support; 8 left heel reaches to next contact. From this REAR camera forward means toward top of image: forward feet are higher and partially occluded, trailing raised sole is visible lower. BOTH alternating legs must actually change which foot supports weight. No duplicated half-cycle, no sideways walk, no moonwalking. Subtle pelvis rotation and rise/fall, restrained opposite arm swing, bow gripped correctly throughout; scarf and cloth secondary motion delayed behind gait. Torso identity and crown height stay nearly constant. Strong readable leg separation, natural knees, correct ankles. The last frame must lead smoothly to first. Small deliberate gait changes only; don't redraw face/hair or change character volume between cells. Feet must not merge. Consistent fine linework and fine material detail across ALL eight frames, same quality as reference, no blur, no chibi redesign, no photorealism.
revision:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Input image is the edit target, an eight-frame 4x2 rear walking sprite sheet. Keep the exact same eight upper bodies, face-away head, compact hair bun, red scarf, cream costume, gold bow, detailed ink illustration, fixed camera and body scale. Correct ONLY the leg walk choreography to a clean symmetric 8 frame WALK cycle. Preserve true transparent alpha background, 4 columns 2 rows, each whole sprite fully separate.
CRITICAL ALL four TOP ROW frames have the anatomical LEFT leg as the primary support leg, while the RIGHT foot is swinging forward (away from camera). Top row 1 RIGHT foot trails down behind, sole facing us; top row 2 RIGHT knee bends with raised sole closer to buttocks; top row 3 RIGHT knee passes beside support leg, shoe partly hidden behind trousers; top row 4 RIGHT foot reaches forward toward top of image, heel touches ground, left heel starts to rise.
ALL four BOTTOM ROW frames repeat these four phases with legs exchanged: RIGHT leg supports and LEFT leg swings. Bottom 1 LEFT foot trails behind lower in image sole visible; bottom 2 LEFT knee bends with sole up toward buttock; bottom 3 LEFT leg passes alongside support, shoe hidden partially behind trousers; bottom 4 LEFT reaches away higher in image, heel touches ground, right heel starts to rise. Do not mirror the whole character: bow always viewer LEFT and scarf always RIGHT. Both legs alternate, no hopping. Knees/ankles anatomically correct, no merged feet. Locked hip center and fixed dimensions, only natural small pelvis bob. Detailed shoes and sole stitching, same textured blue trousers. Do not add floor, text, grids or cast shadows. Clean transparent space between all 8 figures. This is surgical leg correction, not a redesign.
